systems.owner: Ministry of Health; Digital Health Agency as custodian of the ecosystem

systems.system: Kenya Health Management Information Systems project (KeHMIS)
systems.owner: Palladium, funded by PEPFAR through US CDC

note: Reports the launch at the Kenya Health Summit 2026 of four Ministry of Health documents: the Enterprise Architecture Blueprint 2025, the Health Data Governance Framework 2025, the Digital Health Solutions Standards and Guidelines 2025 and the Kenya Digital Health Strategy 2025-2030, developed with Palladium as principal technical partner under CDC funding. A current strategy exists, but the piece names no HMIS or EMR system the strategy covers and describes no system by function, so there is no fact; the launch itself is undated in the body.
